mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 34 degrees by the Verona Public Library under a First Quarter moon. If you are up early, the ISS will be visible at 5:39 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward the Fitchburg and Madison area, reaching high in the sky.

In city news, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver this past Thursday after reports of dangerous driving. No students were injured, and alcohol was ruled out as a factor. Additionally, the City has updated its zoning and sign ordinance and offers an interactive map to help residents identify their specific zoning district.

We have a busy weekend ahead starting today with the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking forward, mark your calendars for yoga at Insight Wellness on October 19, plus trivia nights at Hop Haus and other local spots starting October 20.

On Thursday, officers responded to a report of a bus driver operating while impaired near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace. The driver was arrested, and the department is currently investigating a potential collision with a traffic sign.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM for you to satisfy those cravings.
